mapper.select: SELECT BS.SCENE_NODE_ID id, DECODE(BS.FSCENE_NODEID, NULL, #{fNodeId}, NVL(BT.TABLE_NAME, SDL.ITEM_VALUE)) AS text, "LEVEL" as col FROM BOK_SCENECONFIG BS LEFT JOIN BOK_TABLELIST BT ON BS.NODE_VALUE = BT.TABLE_ID and BS.NODE_ID = 'ACCOUNTEVENTS' LEFT JOIN BOK_TABLEDICT BTD ON BS.NODE_ID = BTD.DICT_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST SDL ON SDL.DICT_CODE = BTD.DICT_SOURCE AND SDL.ITEM_CODE = BS.NODE_VALUE WHERE BS.SCENE_NODE_ID = #{sceneNodeId} ORDER BY BS.SCENE_NODE_ID
SELECT SCENE_NODE_ID AS id FROM BOK_SCENECONFIG WHERE BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND FSCENE_NODEID IS NULL

select SCENE_NODE_ID as sceneNodeId, BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, NODE_ID as nodeId, NODE_VALUE as nodeValue, FSCENE_NODEID as fsceneNodeid, remark, CREATE_USER as createUser, CREATE_DEPT as createDept, CREATE_TIME as createTime, UPDATE_USER as updateUser, UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, "LEVEL" from BOK_SCENECONFIG where SCENE_NODE_ID = #{sceneNodeId}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT
1 AS isExtends,
DECODE(BSS.SCENE_NODE_ID, #{sceneNodeId}, 0, 1) AS isExtends,
BSS.SUBJECT_NO AS subjectId, BSU.SUBJECT_NAME || '（'||BSU.SUBJECT_NO||'）' AS subjectName, BSS.FORM_ELE AS formEle, BT.DICT_NAME AS dictName, BSS.CD_FLAG cdFlag, BSS.UPDATE_TIME updateTime, BSS.ACCOUNT_NET accountNet FROM BOK_SCENESUBJECT BSS LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT BSU ON BSS.SUBJECT_NO = BSU.SUBJECT_NO LEFT JOIN BOK_TABLEDICT BT ON BT.DICT_ID = BSS.FORM_ELE AND BT.DICT_TYPE = #{DATA_TYPEN} WHERE INSTR(#{sceneNodeId}, BSS.SCENE_NODE_ID) = 1 ) ORDER BY isExtends DESC

SELECT SUBJECT_NO AS id, SUBJECT_NAME||'（'||SUBJECT_NO||'）' AS text, BAL_FLAG AS col, SUBJECT_TYPE AS parentId FROM BOK_SUBJECT BS1 WHERE BS1.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM BOK_SUBJECT BS WHERE BS.FSUBJECT_ID = BS1.SUBJECT_NO )

WITH MAX_SCENE_NODE_ID (MAX_SCENE_NODE_ID) as (SELECT SUBSTR(MAX (SCENE_NODE_ID), LENGTH(FSCENE_NODEID) + 1) FROM BOK_SCENECONFIG WHERE 1=1
AND FSCENE_NODEID = #{fsceneNodeid}
AND FSCENE_NODEID is null
GROUP BY FSCENE_NODEID )
SELECT DECODE(MAX_SCENE_NODE_ID, NULL, 1, TO_NUMBER(MAX_SCENE_NODE_ID) + 1) FROM MAX_SCENE_NODE_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE BOK_SCENECONFIG SET NODE_VALUE = #{nodeValue}, REMARK = #{remark} WHERE SCENE_NODE_ID = #{sceneNodeId}
